quoted_fields.interface: Positive spring bath K with diagonal W^2,rail entries-W,rung entries-4W; two ideal spins of energyW and transverse coordinate couplings g sqrt(2W) sigma_x(t q_own+s q_cross),own-rail t>0,s=0. quoted_fields.failure: This is a different Hamiltonian from N1080: its own-rail nonzero interaction does not contradict the original reflected RWA cancellation. The small-g radius is not quantified uniformly near W=8. Engineered massive modes do not give an external gapless vacuum a mass. The owner-proved graded-tail/four-packet interface rules out a uniform rank-one replica gap in the full local parity sector; it gives no specific-coupler decay rate.
